summary: The agent failed test_legacy_pytest_suite because it trusted actual input data (85 staff rows) over the spec's explicit requirement (87 staff, rows 4-90, totals at row 91) when no test_output.py was found. The agent also declared success despite pytest failure. This patch updates excel-workbook-modeling to add explicit decision rules for spec-vs-data discrepancies when building blind, and reinforces the mandatory pytest-pass requirement.
